scope: Native Windows source review and targeted regressions of managed control, media gateway, browser, lifecycle and resource retention
runtime_source: The commit containing this evidence; installed revisions remain independently recorded in docs/release-status.md

findings_fixed.issue: VideoStream retained first-seen metadata for consumed frames indefinitely
findings_fixed.fix: Metadata is removed with consumed/discarded/expired frames; orphan frames expire; depayloader retains at most 64 frames

findings_fixed.issue: Dropping a peer after failed/cancelled negotiation retained its ordinary-runtime driver and UDP socket
findings_fixed.fix: Both runtimes signal durable shutdown and wake blocked senders on final peer drop

findings_fixed.issue: Unbounded control feedback/handoff queues and default unbounded SCTP send buffer
findings_fixed.fix: Bounded message/event queues, send deadline, bounded native SCTP buffering and remote channel/track budgets

findings_fixed.issue: MSE pending frames/history and URL renderer cleanup did not have complete retention/release boundaries
findings_fixed.fix: Frame/byte budgets, native history trimming, explicit cleanup and settled cancelled setup; valid SEI-before-IDR also accepted

findings_fixed.issue: Paired GameStream TLS skipped server certificate identity validation
findings_fixed.fix: Require the exact paired certificate while retaining handshake signature verification; no DNS-name dependency

findings_fixed.issue: GameStream responses could grow without a body limit and only connect timeout was configured
findings_fixed.fix: 8 MiB body budget and full-exchange deadline; Sunshine control client also bounds list/token/error bodies

findings_fixed.issue: Application image cache retained all visited cover keys
Rate limiters owned immortal cleanup goroutines and unlimited identity maps; login trusted spoofable forwarded IPs
findings_fixed.fix: Request-owned expiry, 4096 identity cap, saturating counters, actual peer identity and 16 KiB login body

findings_fixed.issue: Operation log retention existed in configuration but was not started; cleanup hid database errors
findings_fixed.fix: Joined service-owned startup/hourly cleanup, context deadline and reported database errors; failed initialization closes SQLite

findings_fixed.issue: Native management HTTP server had no explicit header or idle deadline
findings_fixed.fix: 10-second header deadline and 60-second idle deadline without imposing a short whole-upload timeout

new_native_cases: Correct paired certificate accepted and wrong pin rejected over actual TLS
9 MiB chunked HTTP response rejected by body budget, not timeout
20000 native packetized frames delivered; partial current frame uses 100 ms deadline
20000 incomplete frames remain within 64 retained frames
Actual native DataChannel handles cannot expand the remote callback queue

browser_decoder.scope: Synthetic encoded input with actual native browser APIs and repository implementations; not full Sunshine transport

verification.review: Ownership, boundedness, cancellation, authorization generation, native TLS, renderer compatibility and changed diff inspected before commit

unchanged_reviewed_boundaries: Management event client/message limits and session history/resume retention
Existing audio/video queues and microphone task cancellation/weak ownership
Android authority generations, single heartbeat/retry, native peer/audio disposal and bounded HTTP body
Sunshine native capture/encode queue ownership; no new renderer binary or GPU-driver endurance claim
Installer/service ownership and existing source versus installed version separation
not_claimed: Universal absence of OOM or exhaustive line-by-line proof of all third-party code
New four-hour/24-hour endurance or hardware reboot acceptance
New installed-version playwright-cli/media acceptance until separately recorded
New Linux/mobile physical-device or Android APK acceptance
Standalone upstream legacy WebSocket mode production readiness; managed mode rejects that route
